name: labs/capotosto__py_instrument_driver_package
title: Keysight E4980A precision LCR meter
intro: Keysight E4980A precision LCR meter, adapted from capotosto/py_instrument_driver_package. It reads `aperture_mode`, `aperture_averages`, `dc_bias_autorange`, `correction_method` and 7 more; sets `measurement_function`, `frequency`, `voltage_level`, `current_level` and 5 more; runs `fetch_formatted`, `fetch_impedance`, `fetch_vac`, `fetch_iac` and 4 more. `fetch_formatted`: fetch the latest formatted measurement: primary value, secondary value and status code. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
